data.one_liner: Dart API client for Mason CLI
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to login, logout, query current user, search, and publish templates to a Mason server. It handles authentication and HTTP communication.
use_when: You need programmatic access to a Mason server from Dart code
You want to integrate Mason template publishing into a build or CI pipeline
You need custom hosted URI support
avoid_when: You only need the Mason CLI and no custom Dart integration
You are building a UI that does not interact with Mason server
strengths: Simple API, no code generation required
weaknesses: No advanced networking features like retries or interceptors
No built-in error handling beyond basic exceptions

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides lower-level HTTP client that can be used directly if you need more control
